newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Russian businessman stabbed to death in Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Russian businessman stabbed to death in Cyprus.

text.p: A Russian was on Friday remanded in custody for three days on suspicion of stabbing to death a visiting Russian businessman in a scuffle at a dinner party.
Sergei Asqerov was remanded by Limassol district court on suspicion of killing Sergei Malekhou, 29.
Police said Malekhou was dead on arrival at a hospital in the southern port city of Limassol on Thursday night after being stabbed in the chest.
The killing occurred at a dinner party at the house of another Russian in the city's plush Germasoyia suburb.
The court ordered the release of the host, Sergei Akaronov, owner of an offshore company, who was detained after the incident.
Police on Friday detained two other Russian men believed to have been present at the dinner party and are searching for two more, a man and a woman.

A police spokesman said of the dead man:"He was at the house with other Russians and a scuffle broke out for unknown reasons. During all the fuss one of them apparently pulled out a knife and fatally injured him in the chest."
The people at the party had consumed considerable quantities of alcohol, he added.
